summary: Security update 5.1.6 for Multi-Linux Manager Server
details:
This update fixes the following issues:

Release Notes Highlights:

- Update to SUSE Multi-Linux Manager 5.1.6
  
  * Added SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 16.1 Family and openSUSE Leap 16.1
    support as clients    
  * Ubuntu 26.04 support as client
  * Deleting a base channel also deletes its activation keys
  * Monitoring: Prometheus upgraded to 3.13.2
  * Monitoring: Grafana upgraded to 12.4.11

Container images and uyuni-tools changes:

server-attestation-image:

- Version 5.1.17
  * Image rebuilt to the newest version with updated dependencies
    for SUSE Multi-Linux Manager 5.1.6

server-hub-xmlrpc-api-image:

- Version 5.1.16
  * Image rebuilt to the newest version with updated dependencies
    for SUSE Multi-Linux Manager 5.1.6

server-image:

- Version 5.1.17
  * Remove salt-call from server image healthcheck (bsc#1276498)
  * Fix error handling at buildtime
  * Increase start-period (bsc#1271124)
  * Check disk space on startup

server-migration-14-16-image:

- Version 5.1.16
  * Image rebuilt to the newest version with updated dependencies
    for SUSE Multi-Linux Manager 5.1.6

server-postgresql-image:

- Version 5.1.17
  * Fixed DB upgrade failure on old installations where the manager
    and report databases were owned by the PostgreSQL superuser
    instead of their application users. Added upgrade script
    04-fix-db-ownership that retroactively corrects ownership
    during upgrade
- Version 5.1.16
  * Increase start-period and timeout (bsc#1271124)
  * Check disk space on startup
  * Autodetect database name based on database user
    (bsc#1272960)

server-saline-image:

- Version 5.1.16
  * Image rebuilt to the newest version with updated dependencies
    for SUSE Multi-Linux Manager 5.1.6

uyuni-tools:

- Version 5.1.33-0
  * Mount --tuning-httpd file as zz_apache_tuning conf so it
    overrides the vendor spacewalk-proxy conf MPM settings
    (bsc#1277719)
  * Run the internal DB SSL rhn.conf migration on every upgrade,
    not only when the DB schema or collation changes (bsc#1277589)
  * Reload systemd daemon before restarting services (bsc#1270033)
  * Bump the default image tag to 5.1.6


The following packages are underlying build dependencies
and system components used by the containers:


liberate-formula:

- Version 0.1.5
  * Exclude kernel package from reinstall (bsc#1269223)

mgr-push:

- Version 5.1.6-0
  * Remove token based authentication mechanism for package_push
    (bsc#1230949)

python-susemanager-retail:

- Update to version 1.2.1
  * Fix issue building package on SLES 16.0

salt-netapi-client:

- Version 0.22.0
  * See: https://github.com/SUSE/salt-netapi-client/releases/tag/v0.22.0 
- Replace the use of Gson's internal newParametrizedTypeWithOwner
- Update JDK and maven plugin versions
- Document signing of Git Commits
- Implement withExecutors for LocalCall
- Use collection factory methods
- Pin GitHub Actions to SHA checksums
- Update pom.xml definition
- Migrate usage of internal GSON API
- Bump gson to version 2.14.0

spacecmd:

- Version 5.1.15-0
  * Warn about activation keys when removing channels (bsc#1233592)
  * Pre-filter errata in system_applyerrata to avoid using
    API calls for all existing errata (bsc#1267261)
  * Fix spacecmd build on SUSE Linux Micro 6

spacewalk-admin:

- Version 5.1.11-0
  * Set crypto-policy when FIPS is enabled (bsc#1270035)
- Version 5.1.10-0
  * Check disk space in uyuni-check-database service
  * Regenerate the OS image trusted CA RPM when the server CA changes
    (bsc#1268892)

spacewalk-backend:

- Version 5.1.20-0
  * Delete activation keys when removing a base channel (bsc#1233592)
  * Allow diskcheck env vars into containers (bsc#1270033)
  * Remove token based authentication mechanism for package_push
    (bsc#1230949)
  * Allow using spacewalk-diskcheck without running service
  * Increase errata advisory char limit to 150 (bsc#1273846)
  * Use cryptographically secure random generation for secrets (bsc#1230568)

spacewalk-config:

- Version 5.1.10-0
  * CVE-2026-71400: Remove cobbler_api endpoint from public interface
    (bsc#1274613, bsc#1274775)


spacewalk-java:

Security issues fixed (CVE):

- CVE-2026-109921: Check that the system can be accessed before
  using its pillar (bsc#1290236) (version 5.1.35)
- CVE-2026-94288: Disallowed external XML entries and DOCTYPE
  when parsing systemid (bsc#1282990) (version 5.1.34)
- CVE-2026-71400: Removed cobbler_api endpoint from public interface
  (bsc#1274613, bsc#1274775) (version 5.1.34)

Bugs fixed:

- Version 5.1.35-0
  * Remove gson version constraint
  * Update java dependencies
- Version 5.1.34-0
  * Added migration paths from SLES4SAP 15SP7 to SLES4SAP 16.0
    (bsc#1286315)
  * Speed up loading package data for repodata generation by
    avoiding a full scan of the checksum table (bsc#1286091)
  * Commit and close the database transaction after connecting to
    the Salt event bus to not block database maintenance
  * Allow all SUSE OS based systems to become a build host
  * Fixed inconsistent SSM and Convert to Proxy buttons state on the
    System Details tabs (bsc#1268632)
  * Fixed image status icon to reflect failed image inspections
    (bsc#1255090)
  * Removed 'Go to OS image directory listing' link from Images page
    (bsc#1251867)
  * Fixed Ansible path API descriptions
  * Committed transaction in syncChannel when repo-sync is running for
    the same channel to prevent possible deadlocks (bsc#1274884)
  * Handled distupgrade to SLE16 for SSH minions (bsc#1268463)
  * Refactored ClmChannelDiff task to use a Queue to execute tasks
    in parallel and keep hibernate cache smaller (bsc#1273021)
  * Fixed CLM stuck in building by waiting for full DB commit in
    ActionExecutor
  * Optimized cloned channel sync queries in `Errata_queries.xml` to
    avoid nested loops (bsc#1273071)
  * Removed traditional stack leftover in dist migration and allowed
    the API to proceed product migration even if there are outstanding
    management stack updates (bsc#1275215)
  * Fixed virtual instance refresh for mixed SSH and regular minions
    (bsc#1254316)
  * Restored the original reset behavior in isDryRun() by swapping
    subscribedChannels and unsubscribedChannels back (bsc#1271681)
  * Fixed config channel position gaps (bsc#1272988)
  * Fixed custom RBAC role names being incorrectly localized
    (bsc#1271116)
  * Improved handling of invalid issue_date values when creating
    CLM filters via the API (bsc#1271467)
  * Fixed HTTP 500 error when creating CLM Template filters
  * Removed activation keys when a base channel is deleted
    (bsc#1233592)
  * Fixed mainframe systems showing wrong OS version (bsc#1260342)
  * Fixed duplicate UI entries in rhel10-like minion package upgrades
    (bsc#1262234)
  * Fixed correct assignment of peripheral entitlement (bsc#1269086)
  * Fixed untranslated strings in jsp pages (bsc#1269948)
  * Fixed Profile tab display in system details menu (bsc#1271963)
  * Allowed diskcheck env vars into containers (bsc#1270033)
  * Separated Live-Patching Errata for SLE15 SP7 (bsc#1270039)
  * Queried only systems for virtual machines which are flagged as
    virtualization hosts (bsc#1273073)
  * Fixed EOL notifications in containers
  * Prevented adding FQDNs from proxy certificates and added error
    message to avoid crashing on conflicting FQDNs (bsc#1270141,
    bsc#1272404)
  * Waited for taskomatic before processing events (bsc#1265472)
  * Fixed Hibernate session crash on Errata Sync by dynamically loading
    default access groups from the active session (bsc#1272298)
  * Fixed race condition when adding or removing a server to or from
    an activation key (bsc#1268744)
  * Accepted both string and array of strings as values for the cves
    field in Ubuntu erratas (bsc#1280946, gh#uyuni-project/uyuni#12544)
  * Processed Ubuntu erratas with no binaries (bsc#1280946)
  * Added a fallback errata ID for Ubuntu errata without identification

Other changes:

- Added migration path for EL10 products
- Enabled product migrations to 16.1 for SLES, SLES for SAP, and
  SLE-RT
- Set default checksum type for new UI channels to sha256
  (bsc#1269011)
- Fixed accessibility markup for mirror credential dialogs
- Changed color of languages and removed spaces in user creation page
- Stopped forcing password-based SAML authentication by default;
  commented out requested AuthnContext defaults shipped in SSO config
  so IdP can pick appropriate authentication method (FIDO2, Yubikey,
  Windows Hello) with strict SAML clients such as Microsoft Edge


spacewalk-web:

- Version 5.1.23-0
  * Bugs fixed:
    - Fixed the Download CSV button URL on the Systems List page
      redirecting to the Systems Overview page, and removed duplicate
      button (bsc#1271972)
    - Fixed image status icon to reflect failed image inspections
      (bsc#1255090)
    - Removed 'Go to OS image directory listing' link from Images page
      (bsc#1251867)
    - Improved handling of invalid issue_date values when creating
      CLM filters via the API (bsc#1271467)
    - Checked type of object before calling 'in' (bsc#1273607)
    - Fixed the 'Clear selected system set' button flickering during
      page navigation (bsc#1271523)
    - Fixed React and Bootstrap modal interoperability and related UI
      warnings
    - Fixed recurring action cleanup and browser navigation
    - Prevented asynchronous updates after manager views and shared
      components unmount
    - Cleaned up SSM WebSocket connections when leaving the page
  * Other changes:
    - Supported legacy CoCo contracts during mixed-version development
    - Added web.version.eol setting to provide an end of life date
    - Refactored checkboxes in the RBAC UI and reused common Check
      component
    - Replaced explicit React Fragment components with shorthand syntax
    - Added Storybook support for Uyuni web components with typed Button
      stories
    - Suppressed CSS order warnings and the error overlay in development
  * Dependency updates:
    - Updated @babel/plugin-transform-modules-systemjs to 7.29.8
    - Updated brace-expansion from version 1.1.12 to 1.1.18
    - Updated browserslist from version 4.26.3 to 4.28.9
    - Bumped moment-timezone to 0.5.38 to remove unused temporary
      tarballs from packaged npm dependency
    - Updated nanoid from 3.3.8 to 3.3.18
    - Updated dompurify from version 3.2.5 to 3.4.15
    - Updated fast-uri to version 3.1.7
    - Updated js-yaml from version 4.1.1 to 4.3.2
    - Updated lodash and lodash-es to version 4.18.1
    - Updated minimatch from version 3.0.5 to 3.1.4
    - Updated picomatch to versions 2.3.2 and 4.0.7
    - Updated postcss from version 8.5.6 to 8.5.28
    - Updated immutable to version 4.3.9

subscription-matcher:

- Added missing part numbers (bsc#1274227, bsc#1265219)
- Fixed unsupported part number (bsc#1271075)

supportutils-plugin-susemanager:

- Version 5.1.7-0
  * Allow 100 connection difference for apache and tomcat
  * Fixed reading connections from the correct source
  * Added reportdb connections to the database connection limit
    (bsc#1262157)

susemanager:

- Version 5.1.20-0
  * Added bootstrap repository definition for SUSE Linux Enterprise
    Server for NVIDIA (ARM64) 16.1

susemanager-build-keys:

- Update Red Hat Release Key 2 (199E2F91FD431D51) to use SHA-256
  binding signature to fix RHEL 10 bootstrap failures. (bsc#1290764)
- Update SUSE addon key - extended validity
  Removed: build-addon-0bad8ecc-632aff67.asc
  Added:   build-addon-0bad8ecc.asc

susemanager-docs_en:

- Documented cloned patch reuse for softwarechannel_clone and
  softwarechannel_clonetree in spacecmd reference (bsc#1282231)
- Clarified requirements for Liberty client registration (bsc#1284967)
- Clarified FQDN requirements for Hub online synchronization (bsc#1275191)
- Expanded and corrected RBAC Web UI documentation (bsc#1258079)
- Documented passwordless sudo requirement for PAYG connections (bsc#1280881)
- Documented SLES 16.1 and openSUSE Leap 16.1 support and migration paths
- Added Multi-Linux Manager MCP Server book
- Fixed published version numbers that dropped a trailing zero, such
  as 2026.10 appearing as 2026.1
- Updated images in documentation with teh correct product name (bsc#1257074)
- Added information about associated activation keys being deleted 
  when channels are deleted in Administration Guide
- Extended proxy troubleshooting section for setting the grains 
  (bsc#1281041)
- Updated information for hardware requirements and a reference 
  to large deployments requirements (bsc#1268473)
- Documented resolving obsolete libvirt-events errors in minion logs 
  (bsc#1272813)
- Added documentation support for Ubuntu 26.04 client systems
- Fixed procedure block formatting and normalized section headings 
  to sentence case
- Documented Salt RBAC namespaces and native Salt access controls
- Added a note to the liberate formula page for special handling 
  of kernel during reinstall (bsc#1269223)
- Documented new Taskomatic schedules (bsc#1273021)
- Removed the sitemaps Antora generates from the 
  documentation.suse.com HTML build
- Updated the documentation.suse.com shared header to version 1.16 
  and marked it as the documentation portal
- Added an English-only edit link on the documentation.suse.com 
  and Uyuni sites so readers can propose a change to the English source
- Clarified requirement to update to the latest maintenance update 
  before upgrading or migrating between versions (bsc#1270262)
- Documented PAYG connection deletion and synchronization behavior, 
  and fixed a broken cross-reference (github#31801)
- Renamed the server and proxy upgrade pages to maintenance update 
  and defined maintenance update, upgrade and migration terminology
- Stopped generating antora.yml in gen-all, where the two products 
  wrote one file in a random order. The `-content-dir` flag of 
  gen-all went to that file alone
- Sped up CI by building only English, which is all the CI artifacts 
  have ever contained
- Clarified relationship between custom RBAC and Salt-API access
- Extracted and relocated general sudo configuration guidelines to a 
  new central page, and added unprivileged onboarding support 
  references for SLE 16 (bsc#1275794)
- Made JOBS=00 an error, which xargs read as unlimited concurrency
- Fixed the PDF archive tasks, which failed when the checkout path 
  contains a space
- Sped up PDF builds by building the books concurrently. JOBS=<n> 
  caps the number of concurrent jobs
- Fixed PDF builds so the two products no longer share one entities 
  file, which could put SUSE Multi-Linux Manager names into Uyuni 
  PDFs and the other way round
- Fixed the pdf-tar tasks, which produced no archive and packaged 
  both products into each one
- Made an empty or incorrect LANGUAGES stop the build instead of 
  reporting success with no output
- Made an exported LANGUAGES set the default language selection
- Made every build task select languages with LANGUAGES
- Added a CI check for the revision date of changed documentation 
  pages
- Removed a link to the SSL CA migration guide, which does not apply 
  to this version
- Fixed noindex guards so product-specific pages no longer appear 
  in the other product's documentation search
- Documented deprecation and support limitations of plain salt-minion 
  manual registration (bsc#1275658)
- Added warning about known issues in Multi-Linux Manager 5.0 and 
  5.1 server upgrade guides (bsc#1274875)
- Corrected and restored Debian 12 packages in the OpenSCAP packages 
  table (bsc#1269316)
- Documented Web UI Reactivation Key field, Salt Bundle configuration 
  paths, and detailed warnings/behaviors for Reactivation Keys (bsc#1211440)
- Documented requirements and limitations for container image 
  inspection on SLES 15 and SLES 16 (bsc#1274720)
- Documented proxy certificate replacement using spacecmd 
  (bsc#1271329)
- Documented allowing diskcheck environment variables into 
  containers (bsc#1270033)
- Added instruction for obtaining the certificate when renaming 
  the server (bsc#1273853)
- Clarified availability of Salt's 'virt' module in the Salt 
  Bundle (bsc#1270694)
- Documented how VMs are listed and referenced by virtual hosts 
  (bsc#1273073)
- Added a common workflow for certificate setup and rotation with 
  ACME
- Extended configuration instructions for Saline formula in 
  Specialized Guides (bsc#1268587)
- Enhanced instructions for Liberate formula and reactivation key 
  in Specialized Guides (bsc#1268473)
- Consolidated multiple duplicated activation key creation procedures 
  into a single reusable partial snippet
- Added instructions for enabling reporting dashboards in Specialized 
  Guides (bsc#1268228)
- Documented apache2 parameter used for large deployments 
  (bsc#1268673)
- Fixed `task validate:mlm` and `task validate:uyuni` to use Antora 3 
  built-in xref checking (`stage-content`, `gen-site`, `gen-antora`, 
  `--log-failure-level=error`) instead of the obsolete Antora 2.x 
  `@antora/xref-validator` plugin, which was not shipped in the builder image
- Migrated the build to committed AI translation trees (`ja/`, `ko/`, 
  `zh/modules/`) with English fallback via `task stage-content`; 
  po4a/Weblate are no longer used in the build pipeline
- Updated PDF builds to stage translated content from `{content_dir}/modules/` 
  before `gen-pdf-nav`; consolidated Uyuni CJK PDF output onto the shared 
  `uyuni-cjk` theme
- Fixed sibling `ifeval` blocks in SUSE Liberty Linux client registration
  (`clients-sleses.adoc`) that caused unterminated conditional errors 
  in CJK PDF builds
- Documented Grafana reporting database automated setup and Hub Overview 
  in Administration and Specialized Guides
- Update the OpenSCAP packages table in the System Security with 
  OpenSCAP article in the Administration guide (bsc#1269316)
- Added documentation for migrating legacy ISS v1 and ISS v2 peripheral 
  servers to ISS v3 (Hub Online Synchronization) and detailed Report 
  DB/XMLRPC API dependencies in Specialized Guides 

susemanager-schema:

- Version 5.1.22-0
  * Fix planner estimates for package files, provides and changelogs
    to avoid slow parallel queries during repodata generation
    (bsc#1286091)
- Version 5.1.21-0
  * Fix Ansible path descriptions in access-control groups
  * Create a Queue table for ClmChannelDiff (bsc#1273021)
  * Support '/next' directory for easier schema upgrade during
    development and when providing PTFs
  * Renumber config channel positions to close gaps left by deleting
    an assigned config channel (ON DELETE CASCADE did not compact
    the survivors), preventing multiple failures (bsc#1272988)
  * RBAC: add missing endpoints to 'systems.profiles' namespace
    (bsc#1271963)
  * Use temp table for hidden packages (bsc#1267912)
  * Separate Live-Patching Errata for SLE15 SP7 (bsc#1270039)
  * Increase advisory char limit to 150 in
    rhnErrata (bsc#1273846)
  * Fix failed repo-sync due to wrong size of reason column
    (bsc#1281412)

 * Allow OS image templates to have just two numbers as a version

uyuni-reportdb-schema:

- Version 5.1.8-0
  * Support '/next' directory for easier schema upgrade during
    development and when providing PTFs
  * Increase advisory name char limit to 150 in Errata tables
    (bsc#1273846)

How to apply this update:

1. Log in as root user to the SUSE Multi-Linux Manager Server.
2. Upgrade mgradm and mgrctl.
3. If you are in a disconnected environment, upgrade the image packages.
4. Reboot the system.
5. Run `mgradm upgrade podman` which will use the default image tags.
